stages.description: Pre-deploy footgun linter (compose parse, Traefik cert-case/tls label, healthcheck host, no build: in stage/prod, push.sh login guard, start.sh project-name, shellcheck).
Audit-finding output-contract validator self-test (report-schema.json shape checks).
Deterministic code-review pre-scope manifest (security.md lens + audit-app.sh scanner map per changed file).
Design anti-slop gate advisory pass (D1-D8 cardinal sins + P1a-P1u taste advisories).
Mockup-anchored layout-fidelity gate — built app vs the approved docs/MOCKUP.jsx baseline.
Cross-artifact gap check — PRODUCT.md <-> inputs.yml <-> schema <-> IMPLEMENTATION_MAP.md <-> STATE.md <-> primer.yml drift/staleness.
Tier-1 audit (Gitleaks, Semgrep, tsc, ESLint) — cheap static scan.
Tier-2 audit (Trivy, OSV-Scanner, Syft SBOM, BackstopJS) — moderate-cost scan.
Deterministic full-audit pre-scope manifest (target-type classification + audit-dimension/gate map).
Readiness-vs-liveness smoke (health endpoint, login flow, authed data/page routes).
